name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  test-ubuntu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        emacs-version:
          - '26.3'
          - '27.2'
          - '28.2'
          - '29.4'
          - 'snapshot'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Emacs
        uses: purcell/setup-emacs@master
        with:
          version: ${{ matrix.emacs-version }}

      - name: Install Cask
        uses: conao3/setup-cask@master
        with:
          version: 'snapshot'

      - name: Install server build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y make automake autoconf gcc g++ \
            libpng-dev libpoppler-glib-dev libpoppler-private-dev \
            libz-dev pkg-config

      - name: Compile epdfinfo server
        run: make autobuild

      - name: Install Elisp dependencies
        run: cask install

      - name: Run tests
        run: make test

  test-macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    env:
      HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: 1
      HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: 1
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Emacs
        uses: purcell/setup-emacs@master
        with:
          version: '29.4'

      - name: Install Cask
        uses: conao3/setup-cask@master
        with:
          version: 'snapshot'

      - name: Install server build dependencies
        run: |
          brew install automake autoconf poppler pkg-config gnu-sed
          echo "$(brew --prefix gnu-sed)/libexec/gnubin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Compile epdfinfo server
        run: make autobuild

      - name: Install Elisp dependencies
        run: cask install

      - name: Run tests
        run: make test

  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: msys2 {0}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          update: true
          install: >-
            git
            base-devel
            autoconf
            automake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-toolchain
            mingw-w64-x86_64-libpng
            mingw-w64-x86_64-poppler
            mingw-w64-x86_64-imagemagick
            mingw-w64-x86_64-zlib
            mingw-w64-x86_64-openssl
            mingw-w64-x86_64-emacs

      - name: Install Cask
        run: git clone https://github.com/cask/cask ~/.cask

      - name: Compile epdfinfo server
        run: |
          export PATH="$HOME/.cask/bin:$PATH"
          make autobuild

      - name: Package Windows binaries
        run: |
          mkdir -p pack
          cp server/epdfinfo.exe pack/
          ldd server/epdfinfo.exe | grep mingw | cut -d' ' -f3 | xargs -I {} cp {} pack/
          cp /mingw64/bin/libcrypto*.dll pack/ || true
          cp /mingw64/bin/libssl*.dll pack/ || true

      - name: Upload Windows artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: epdfinfo-mingw64
          path: pack/

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
